license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice, or to offer to practice, engineering in this state, as defined in the provisions of this chapter, or to use in connection with his or her name or otherwise assume, or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that he or she is an engineer, unless that person has been registered or exempted under the provisions of this chapter.

accrediting_body.quote: "Accredited program" means specific engineering curricula within established institutions of higher learning that have both met the criteria of, and have been designated by, the following commissions of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology, Inc. ("ABET"): the Engineering Accreditation Commission ("ABET-EAC") and the Engineering Technology Accreditation Commission ("ABET-ETAC").

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration shall expire on the last day of the month of June following their issuance and become invalid after that date unless renewed.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Certificates of registration must be renewed prior to, or during the month of, June by the payment of a fee set by the board in an amount not less than one hundred fifty dollars ($150), but not to exceed one hundred eighty dollars ($180).

required.quote: Subject to the approval of the director, the board of engineers shall establish any rules and regulations for the conduct of its own proceedings; for examination of applicants; for registration of professional engineers and engineers-in-training; for continuing education requirements

available.quote: A person holding a current certificate of registration to engage in the practice of engineering, on the basis of comparable written NCEES examinations, issued to him or her by either a proper authority of a state, territory, or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or of any foreign country, and whose qualifications meet the requirements of this chapter, based on verified evidence may, upon application, be registered without further examination.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current certificate of registration from another state/territory/DC/foreign country based on comparable NCEES examinations, and qualifications must meet RI requirements; OR hold an NCEES Record meeting RI requirements. Registration granted without further examination.
requirements.quote: A person holding a NCEES Record, whose qualifications as evidenced by the NCEES Record meet the requirements of this chapter, may, upon application, be registered without further examination, provided he or she is qualified.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing engineering in this state in violation of the standards of professional conduct established by the board and approved by the director;

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, recklessness, gross negligence, misconduct, or incompetence in the practice of engineering;

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of an engineer's stamp in violation of § 5-8-14;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or chapter 84 of this title.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of this chapter or chapter 84 of this title;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice engineering in another state or jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice engineering before any state or before any other country or jurisdiction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or specified crimes such as forgery, embezzlement, bribery, larceny, extortion, or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to any felony or to any crime of, or an act constituting a crime of, forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, or any other similar offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish legally requested information to the department and/or board in a reasonable time.

disciplinary_grounds.description: In conjunction with other violations, conduct reflecting adversely on the licensee's fitness to practice engineering.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In conjunction with any violation of subsections (b)(1) — (b)(9), any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to engage in the practice of engineering;

disciplinary_grounds.description: In conjunction with other violations, any other conduct discreditable to the engineering profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In conjunction with any violation of subsections (b)(1) — (b)(9), any other conduct discreditable to the engineering profession.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: every firm must obtain a certificate of authorization from the board and those individuals in direct control of the practice and who exercise direct supervision of all personnel who act in behalf of the firm in professional and technical matters must be registered with the board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of engineering" means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to services or creative work, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation surveys, planning and design of engineering systems, and the supervision of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with specifications; and embracing those services or work in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work, or projects in which the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health, or property is concerned.

board_engineering_disciplines_represente.quote: The registration system shall provide, at a minimum, for the registration of: (i) Civil engineers; (ii) Chemical engineers; (iii) Electrical engineers; (iv) Mechanical engineers; (v) Structural engineers; (vi) Environmental engineers; and (vii) Fire protection engineers.
